1. Macro Summary
The current macro environment indicates a neutral monetary policy with stable rates and a positive yield spread. Inflation is rising, but core inflation remains below 3%. GDP growth is also rising, while the labor market shows moderate trends. Liquidity conditions are easing, supporting a risk-on equity regime.

2. Monetary Policy Assessment
The Federal Funds Rate is 3.64% and stable. The 10-year Treasury yield is 4.47%, and the 2-year Treasury yield is 4.0%, resulting in a positive yield spread of 0.47%. The overall policy stance is neutral.

3. Inflation & Growth Assessment
CPI year-over-year is 3.95% and is on a rising trend. Core CPI year-over-year is 2.99%. GDP growth quarter-over-quarter is 0.49% and is also on a rising trend. The unemployment rate is 4.3%, indicating a moderate trend in the labor market.

4. Liquidity & Credit Conditions
The Chicago Fed National Financial Conditions Index (NFCI) is -0.524, and the corporate credit spread is 0.76. These indicators suggest an easing liquidity regime and a risk-on environment.

5. Yield Curve Interpretation
The 10-year/2-year yield spread is 0.47%, which is positive, indicating a normal yield curve and generally favorable economic expectations.

6. Equity Risk Regime (Risk-On / Neutral / Risk-Off)
Risk-On

7. Confidence Score (1-10)
7
